title: Scoring Run Manifest
description: Records provenance for every automated scoring run (RF10 remediation). One file per run.

prompt_path.description: Repo-relative path to the system prompt source

prompt_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the system prompt text at run time

n_frames.description: Number of frames scored in this run

git_commit.description: Short git commit hash at run time

output_file.description: Repo-relative path to the output JSON
